name: restaurant-of-menus
why: Opens on "Your N.I.H. spends forty-seven billion dollars a year"; the restaurant that serves menus faints when one plate of medicine comes out, ending on "reluctantly, science."

name: greed-never-cancels
why: "Altruism is lovely but flaky": the saint cancels by phone, the fat cat is through the lab door before his alarm, ending on "the only one worth building on."

name: lobbyist-vacuum
why: Opens on "lobbyists find money ... the way a dog finds a vacuum cleaner"; he tries six ways in, each fails, and he puts on a lab coat.
